corrections.claimed_speedup: README: up to 25.8 Gsymbol/s decode (~29 GB/s payload at ~9 bits/symbol) for rans32_16 with num_interleaves=32 on an RTX 2080 Ti with rows >= 2048. Sparse inverse-CDF table: up to 2.8x on CPU and +80% on CUDA over its own default lookup. benchmark_status.md compares v0.3.0 to v0.2.1 only (CPU 1-way decode 1.27x-1.44x). corrections.caveats: No head-to-head against torchac, CompressAI, dietgpu or Huffman; all numbers are self-comparisons (own lookup variants, own releases), so it is evidence of speed, not of beating a named baseline. The 1058/6149 MB/s example figures are rans64 encode (push) throughput, not decode. No compiler or flags stated. Last commits (2026-09-14) include automated build-status-table updates.
